description: Order denying early interrogatories and leave to amend
docket_title: ORDER - It ORDERED that Plaintiff's Motions to Serve Three Interrogatories 15 and Motion to Serve Four Interrogatories 54 are DENIED as premature. The Court interprets these Motions as requests for expedited discovery concerning Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) and Meta Platforms, Inc., respectively. At this time, the Court cannot issue an order concerning Plaintiff's Motions because discovery has not officially begun in this case. Pursuant to the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, discovery officially begins when the District Judge issues a Scheduling Order and currently there is no Scheduling Order in this case. It is further ORDERED that Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File Second Amended Complaint 59 is DENIED. Plaintiff was given ample opportunity to comply with the Court's September 9, 2026 Order 64 by producing a redlined Second Amended Complaint but has failed to do so as of the date of this Order. Signed by Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis on 10/07/2026. (lgue, )

                                              ORDER
         These matters are before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion under Federal Rule of Civil

  Procedure 26(d)(1) for Leave to Serve Three Limited Interrogatories on NCMEC Before the Rule

  26(f) Conference (“Motion to Serve Three Interrogatories”) [Dkt. No. 15], Plaintiff’s Motion under

  Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1) for Leave to Serve Four Limited Interrogatories on Meta

  Platforms, Inc, Before the Rule 26(f) Conference (“Motion to Serve Four Interrogatories”) [Dkt.

  No. 54], and Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second Amended and Supplemental Complaint

  Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a)(2) and 15(d), and Request for Expedited

  Determination on the Papers (“Motion for Leave to File Second Amended Complaint”) [Dkt. No.

  59] (collectively “the Motions”). Upon consideration of the Motions, it is hereby

         ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motions to Serve Three Interrogatories [Dkt. No. 15] and

  Motion to Serve Four Interrogatories [Dkt. No. 54] are DENIED as premature. The Court

  interprets these Motions as requests for expedited discovery concerning Defendants National

  Center for Missing & Exploited Children (“NCMEC”) and Meta Platforms, Inc., respectively. At

  this time, the Court cannot issue an order concerning Plaintiff’s Motions because discovery has

  not officially begun in this case. Pursuant to the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, discovery

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD            Document 84   Filed 10/07/26    Page 2 of 2 PageID# 816

  officially begins when the District Judge issues a Scheduling Order and currently there is no

  Scheduling Order in this case. It is further

         ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second Amended Complaint [Dkt.

  No. 59] is DENIED. Plaintiff was given ample opportunity to comply with the Court’s September

  9, 2026 Order [Dkt. No. 64] by producing a redlined Second Amended Complaint but has failed

  to do so as of the date of this Order.

          ENTERED this 7th day of October 2026.
                                                                          /s/
                                                           Ivan D. Davis
         Alexandria, Virginia                              United States Magistrate Judge
